title: Ablation
summary: ABLA'TION, noun [Latin ab and latio, a carrying.] A carrying away. In medicine, the taking from the body whatever is hurtful; evacuations in general. In chimistry, the removal of whatever is finished

inlines.v: ABLA'TION, noun [Latin ab and latio, a carrying.] A carrying away. In medicine, the taking from the body whatever is hurtful; evacuations in general. In chimistry, the removal of whatever is finished or no longer necessary.
